text:
francesca: Quick pulse check  vendors flagged thermal-induced sustained-power derates that could change H100/H200 slotting and our marketplace announce waves. Need contingency plan for SI demos and press.
dave: Which SKUs + numbers? rough ranges pls.
hua_amd: AMD internal: MI300 long-seq dropped ~7-11% in partner labs under 95th-percentile PUE. Partner-preview image available Mon.
lucas_nvidia: Nvidia: some H200 blades show ~10-13% drop at sustained rack load. Microcode tweak under validation, ETA mid-week.
meenal: Ops: if derate >10% we should consider reducing concurrent slot allocations or enable B200 fallback. Also need a routing policy for long-context models.
oscar: Product preference: avoid blocking announce unless >12% derate on GA SKUs. Publish "initial availability" + provisional perf profiles otherwise.
kevin_ops: Proposed flags: `sku_flags: ["available","provisional_perf","pending_vendor_patch"]` and a gating CSV: `region,sku,flag,expected_fix_date`. I'll produce template.
rachel_marketing: Marketing wants a 72h buffer for public press changes. Legal prefers 48h for partner notes. Can we align on 72h for press and 48h for partner comms?
francesca: Sounds reasonable. Partnerships will draft partner note and an embargo decision tree.
lucas_nvidia: We'll share compat matrix and partner-preview when validation finishes. For now hold public statements.
hua_amd: AMD will upload preview microcode to the partner bucket and include test configs.
meenal: Deploy-bot, can you schedule perf sweeps in staging-us-east-1 and eu-west-1 once images land? Include long-context (8k+) and short workloads.
deploy-bot: scheduled perf-sweep jobs #7782 (us-east-1) and #7783 (eu-west-1). ETA 5h after images detected. Results posted to /internal/hw-perf/ with CSV link. :white_check_mark:
dave: SI dry-run guidance: run internal canary but delay outward customer demos 48-72h until we validate vendor patches. Keep SIs informed with a "soft hold" message.
kevin_ops: Routing policy draft: if H200 derate >10% AND MI300 capacity available, route seq>8k to MI300 pools; else route to B200 with throttles. I'll open a PR for routing-policy v1.achel_marketing: Messaging: banner copy draft: "Performance profiles provisional pending vendor firmware updates. See partner note for measured deltas." Legal ok?
francesca: Legal sign-off needed but draft looks good. Action items: 1) Partnerships draft partner note + embargo tree (francesca). 2) Ops create gating CSV + sku_flags (kevin_ops). 3) Eng run perf sweeps and post CSVs (deploy-bot/ops). 4) Product add banner + SKU badge (oscar). 5) Marketing/Legal finalize press buffer & correction template (rachel_marketing). Vendors: upload preview images and compat matrices. Reconvene after perf CSVs or sooner if vendor ETA changes. :calendar:
